machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

method.scheduler: Pinned FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler with dynamic exponential shift and terminal sigma 0.02
method.reference: Pinned official Diffusers BF16 transformer on MPS; FP32 Euler update cast back to BF16 after every step
method.native: FP32 activations, BF16 dense weights, affine-Q8/group-64 selected tail matrices, identical per-step BF16 latent rounding
method.cache: Step 1 extracts post-RoPE prefix K and raw V; steps 2-40 execute target rows only from the same 32-layer cache

interpretation: The final 1.00476% latent nRMSE is accumulated complete-runtime divergence from official BF16 execution, not a quantization-only number. The native path retains FP32 transformer activations but deliberately reproduces the scheduler's BF16 cast-back after each Euler update. The checkpoint-specific gates preserve the observed growth instead of masking early regressions behind one loose final tolerance. A preceding corrected-oracle run produced identical errors and 145779 ms summed GPU time; the recorded timing is the final rebuilt run against the tightened limits.
limitations: The 1-step and 2-step commands validate prefixes of the official 40-step schedule; they are not separate one-step or two-step schedules.
The trajectory is 256px so a 40-step regression remains practical. The earlier independent scale gate covers 512px and 1024px single-step execution.
Summed GPU time excludes packed-file validation, pipeline compilation, CPU scheduler work, and process startup; every kernel still uses a separate command buffer and synchronous wait.
Prompt embeddings and initial noise are precomputed fixtures. Native prompt encoding and RNG remain later boundaries.
No VAE decode is included; this gate ends at the latent after scheduler step 40.
